needs.premise: Two child identities, one relocation epoch and atomic registry/snapshot/OS-result observations; environmental no-child/stop receipts. No C/source, arbitrary-N or liveness proof.
Selected guard-preservation, root coverage, partial failure and accounting laws; no full QNT Step induction or C simulation.

Generator _ptree2/_t-c-1/_t-c-2/_t-c-3 and tracked _kernel.c establish exact selected CFUN shape. Preserve frame/context roots and origin across C value/sop copies; selected generated profile freshness and all raw writers remain open.

Registry close and root acceptance linearize in one domain; frozen complete caller view covers closed-round deferral. Snapshot membership and relocation exclusion cannot be inferred from release/acquire alone.

Separate prepared capacity, stable routing descriptors, bound native children and committed collector members. Current processor_count drives barrier and GC partitioning; changing it needs a real generation transition, not a renamed scalar.

Track each setup and OS-create attempt separately. Known failure cannot revoke siblings; unknown outcome blocks reuse, cleanup or retry. Exact setup_pstate/cleanup domains, callback effects and join/stop evidence need source refinement.
Concrete lock/atomic publication, frozen-view pins, snapshot drain and generation commit; successful create does not order later root relocation. No native C-memory receipt.
No cached movable thunk across sync; context binding and exact collector epoch are ready before root reload and activation acceptance.
Activation slots fully initialized before registration; source overlap until accepted; marker failure/rethrow funnel after END_TRY; unique marker clear/drop before status.

Collector-updateable RootView scanner for every context, nested view lifetime, native borrow exclusion, old-reader pin and relocation reload; processor0 RC scanning does not close arbitrary-owner roots.

orders.orderContract: Close entry admission, prove no child or exact stop, detach membership, drain scanner/descriptor readers, then cleanup/reuse exact PSTATE.
